limits: Profile/scalars are observed data only; sampling perturbs timing. No old timeout cause inferred.

Same-identity endpoint CPU totals may bridge unobserved periods and exclude launch/exit edges. Classification windows require consecutive scans, spacing<=3s and no target/global observed gap; this is a conservative reader guard, not a test assertion or performance PASS threshold.
Process totals include threads; never sum task CPU into process CPU. State/wchan are dated snapshots, not lock ownership.
Cgroup mapping must be established for a child; shared totals never exclusively attributed. Pressure or apparent waiting alone does not prove a product defect.

One authorized diagnostic consumed; final joint verdict requires manual evidence/source review and must be narrow defect/remedy, justified environment budget with separate performance hold, or bounded blocker. No automatic further diagnostic/retry.
